question: What claim of uniqueness is being made about this knowledge by denying that anything equal to it will exist again?
premises: There is knowledge equal to this.
No knowledge equal to this will exist again.
The negation is repeated for emphasis.
inference: Knowledge equal to this is unique and will not exist again.
uncertainties: The scope of 'again' in time is not specified here.
plain_english: There is no knowledge equal to this; again there will not be.
